2607.06988.title: WAM-TTT: Steering World-Action Models by Watching Human Play at Test Time
2607.06988.paper_summary: Steering robot foundation models (RFMs) toward new task variants or user-preferred behaviors remains challenging, often requiring additional robot demonstrations, task-specific fine-tuning, or long-context conditioning. We present WAM-TTT, a test-time training framework for steering world action models from raw human videos. Rather than treating human videos as trajectories to imitate, WAM-TTT absorbs them into a lightweight adaptive memory inside a frozen WAM through self-supervised video prediction. To make this memory useful for control, we introduce a meta-training stage that aligns human demonstrations with robot behaviors using paired human-robot data and a key--value memory reconstruction objective. At test time, only unlabeled human videos are required to adapt the memory, while the pretrained WAM remains frozen. This enables efficient and reusable steering without robot actions, human-side annotations, or task-specific fine-tuning, while preserving the generalization ability of the foundation model. Extensive experiments show that WAM-TTT consistently outperforms in-context human-video conditioning baselines across diverse manipulation tasks and generalization settings.
2607.06988.paper_summary_zh: 引導機器人基礎模型（RFM）朝向新的任務變體或用戶偏好的行為仍然具有挑戰性，通常需要額外的機器人示範、任務特定的微調或長上下文條件。<lb/>我們提出了 WAM-TTT，一個用於從原始人類視頻引導世界行動模型的測試時訓練框架。<lb/>WAM-TTT 並不是將人類視頻視為要模仿的軌跡，而是通過自我監督的視頻預測將其吸收到一個輕量級的自適應記憶中，該記憶位於一個凍結的 WAM 內部。<lb/>為了使這個記憶對控制有用，我們引入了一個元訓練階段，該階段使用配對的人類-機器人數據和一個鍵值記憶重建目標來對齊人類示範與機器人行為。<lb/>在測試時，只需要未標記的人類視頻來適應記憶，而預訓練的 WAM 保持凍結。<lb/>這使得在不需要機器人行動、人類側註釋或任務特定微調的情況下，能夠高效且可重用地進行引導，同時保留基礎模型的泛化能力。<lb/>大量實驗表明，WAM-TTT 在各種操作任務和泛化設置中，始終優於上下文人類視頻條件基準。
